message.content: The largest planet that has been confirmed so far is the protoplanet **HD 100546 b**. It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a radius of roughly **2.5–3 times that of Jupiter**, making it the biggest planet (or planetary‑mass object) that astronomers have detected in our galaxy.
